title: Haryana government employee cashless medical pathway Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: State employee healthcare arrangement providing cashless or reimbursed treatment according to applicable Haryana rules.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligible Haryana government employees/pensioners and covered dependants.

nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Haryana government employee cashless medical pathway.
